title: VIETNAM?
sub: Who chose the name Vietnam? The answer involves a request, a refusal, and two words swapped.
say: Who chose the name Vietnam? The answer involves a request, a refusal, and two words swapped.

title: BEFORE
sub: For centuries the state called itself Đại Việt. Chinese courts used another name: An Nam.
say: For centuries the state called itself Dye Vee-et. Chinese courts used another name: Ahn Nahm.

sub: In 1802, Nguyễn Ánh took the reign name Gia Long and soon held the land from the south to Thăng Long. Next, he sought recognition from the Qing court.
say: In eighteen oh two, Nwin Ahn took the reign name Zah Long and soon held the land from the south to Tahng Long. Next, he sought recognition from the Qing court.

title: THE REQUEST
sub: Around the end of 1802, his envoys asked for a name: Nam Việt. His letters tied it to his family's southern lands.
say: Around the end of eighteen oh two, his envoys asked for a name: Nahm Vee-et. His letters tied it to his family's southern lands.

title: THE OBJECTION
sub: The Jiaqing Emperor objected. An ancient kingdom called Nanyue, or Nam Việt, had ruled lands in today's southern China. Qing records show the court feared the name could imply a claim to those lands. It preferred An Nam.
say: The Jyah-ching Emperor objected. An ancient kingdom called Nahn-yweh, or Nahm Vee-et, had ruled lands in today's southern China. Qing records show the court feared the name could imply a claim to those lands. It preferred Ahn Nahm.

title: REVERSED
sub: The Nguyễn court did not want An Nam. In 1803, the Qing approved a new name instead: the same two words, reversed. Việt Nam.
say: The Nwin court did not want Ahn Nahm. In eighteen oh three, the Qing approved a new name instead: the same two words, reversed. Vee-et Nahm.

title: TWO READINGS
sub: A 2024 study of both courts' records finds two readings. For the Qing, Nam marked a new vassal. The Nguyễn chronicle tied Nam to expansion southward.
say: A twenty twenty-four study of both courts' records finds two readings. For the Qing, Nam marked a new vassal. The Nwin chronicle tied Nam to expansion southward.

sub: In 1804, the Qing invested Gia Long as king of Việt Nam. His court made it the state name.
say: In eighteen oh four, the Qing invested Zah Long as king of Vee-et Nahm. His court made it the state name.

title: OLDER?
sub: The words themselves were older. Việt Nam appears in some earlier texts and inscriptions, but not as the official state name.
say: The words themselves were older. Vee-et Nahm appears in some earlier texts and inscriptions, but not as the official state name.

title: NOT THE END
sub: In the late 1830s, Minh Mạng renamed the state Đại Nam. In 1945, rival governments both took the name Việt Nam.
say: In the late eighteen thirties, Ming Mahng renamed the state Dye Nahm. In nineteen forty-five, rival governments both took the name Vee-et Nahm.

title: RICE & EMPIRES
sub: A name that two courts read in two ways. Follow for more.
say: A name that two courts read in two ways. Follow for more.
